description: Radiación Solar Total anual is a dataset listed in City of Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data), an open data portal, published or maintained by Subsecretaría de Planeamiento. El dataset presenta el análisis de potencial energético solar, a escala catastral, para los barrios de la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires. Coverage: Ciudad de Buenos Aires. The portal files it under the publisher Subsecretaría de Planeamiento. Its tags are ambiente, cambio climático, sustentabilidad. It offers 10 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-06-09 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-caba-portal.
